title: APA 7th Edition Empirical Results Drafting with Persian Typography Standards
description: Authoritative academic behavioral benchmark case for RESULTS_WRITING.
research_question: Are ANCOVA empirical findings drafted following Saber's 5-part epistemic structure, Persian leading zeros, and zero ghost citations?

must_do.description: Adhere to Saber's 5-part epistemic paragraph structure (Hypothesis -> Test -> Stats -> Interpretation -> Table).
Preserve Persian leading zeros (۰.۰۰۱, ۰.۰۵, ۰.۱۶) and report p < ۰.۰۰۱ instead of p = .000.
Generate synchronized triad of artifacts on disk (.docx, .md, .json) per Directive 3.

must_not_do.description: Report p = .000 or omit leading zeros in Persian (.۰۰۱).
Include external literature citations in Chapter 4 empirical results narrative.
Use robotic AI cliches like 'شایان ذکر است که'.

required_evidence.description: APA 7 3-line table with decoupled LTR numbers.
